title: Dicee Challenge Step 0 - Download the Skeleton Project
section: 17. Boss Level Challenge 1 - The Dicee Game
summary: Admin article: the Dicee starter files are available from the course's shared resources list page; download and unzip them before starting.

concepts.heading: Getting the starter files
points: Starter files come from the course's resource list site (appbrewery.co web development resources page), linked in the lecture.
Download the zip and extract it before opening it in the editor.
The skeleton contains the Dicee HTML, CSS and dice images (dice1 to dice6).

task.name: Step 0: Get the skeleton
task.goal: Have the skeleton project unzipped locally and open in the editor.
steps: Open the resources list page linked in the lecture.
Unzip it into your projects folder and open the folder in VS Code.
task.expected_result: A folder containing index.html, styles.css and an images folder.
task.reference_repo_path: Section 17 - Boss Level Challenge 1 - The Dicee Game

pitfalls: Opening the zip without extracting it first.
